function.arguments: {"observation": "`species` and `island` are strongly associated — for example, Adelie penguins are almost exclusively on Torgersen, Chinstrap on Dream, and Gentoo on Biscoe.", "implication": "This means that any comparison of flipper length by species is confounded by island. If we naively compute mean flipper length by species without accounting for island, the observed differences may reflect island effects rather than true species differences. We must either stratify by island or use a model that adjusts for island to get a valid estimate of species effect."}
function.name: note_finding
